The committed `vrm/Seed-san.vrm` file is a practical VRM 1.0 avatar sample
covering PBR materials, MToon materials, spring bones, rotation constraints,
expressions, UV transforms, and expression-driven look-at metadata. Its embedded
VRM metadata allows redistribution and modification redistribution, with credit
required.
